title: Memory of a Lifetime
text: What a magnificent tour!  We were thrilled to have Jordi again as our guide.  He was our tour guide for the Barcelona Gothic Quarter.  The Sagrada Família by Gaudi is special on its own but Jordi made it extraordinary.  He has a wonderful way of making the tour interactive by involving tour participants in the meaning and teachings of the Bible to better understand the vision of Gaudi.  Again, thank you Jordi for making the tour a memory of a lifetime.  Robin & Jose
author: OnAir18040258296

title: Tour Sagrad Familia and Park Guell with ease
text: Jordi is a passionate and week-informed tour guide! He navigated us through Sagrada Família and Park Guell with ease, clearly appreciating each space while sharing his wealth of knowledge with us. We spent 2 hours at Sagrada Família, then taxi’d to Park Guell, where we wandered and learned for another 40 minutes or so. Our experience was everything we wanted in a tour - engaging, informative and stress-free. Muchas gracias!
